items.title: Mozambique: Industrial licences to be automatically approved if state misses statutory deadlines; digital licences to carry QR codes
items.summary: Applications for industrial licences in Mozambique will be automatically approved from November if the state fails to respond within the statutory deadlines, and licences will be issued digitally with QR codes, under a new regulation. The Regulation on Industrial Activity Licensing, obtained by Lusa on Tuesday, replaces the framework in force since 2014, introducing changes… Source
